class.name: OcgAISColorscale
class.brief_description: Class for drawing a custom color scale.
class.description: ! Class for drawing a custom color scale. ! ! The color scale consists of rectangular color bar (composed of fixed ! number of color intervals), optional labels, and title. ! The labels can be positioned either at the boundaries of the intervals, ! or at the middle of each interval. ! Colors and labels can be either defined automatically or set by the user. ! Automatic labels are calculated from numerical limits of the scale, ! its type (logarithmic or plain), and formatted by specified format string.

method.name: AIS_ColorScale
method.description: Default constructor.

method.name: FindColor_1
method.description: Calculate color according passed value; returns true if value is in range or false, if isn't

method.name: GetMin
method.description: Returns minimal value of color scale, 0.0 by default.

method.name: SetMin
method.description: Sets the minimal value of color scale.

method.name: GetMax
method.description: Returns maximal value of color scale, 1.0 by default.

method.name: SetMax
method.description: Sets the maximal value of color scale.

method.name: GetRange
method.description: Returns minimal and maximal values of color scale, 0.0 to 1.0 by default.

method.name: SetRange
method.description: Sets the minimal and maximal value of color scale. Note that values order will be ignored - the minimum and maximum values will be swapped if needed. ::SetReversed() should be called to swap displaying order.

method.name: HueMin
method.description: Returns the hue angle corresponding to minimum value, 230 by default (blue).

method.name: HueMax
method.description: Returns the hue angle corresponding to maximum value, 0 by default (red).

method.name: HueRange
method.description: Returns the hue angle range corresponding to minimum and maximum values, 230 to 0 by default (blue to red).

method.name: SetHueRange
method.description: Sets hue angle range corresponding to minimum and maximum values. The valid angle range is [0, 360], see Quantity_Color and Quantity_TOC_HLS for more details.

method.name: ColorRange
method.description: Returns color range corresponding to minimum and maximum values, blue to red by default.

method.name: SetColorRange
method.description: Sets color range corresponding to minimum and maximum values.

method.name: GetLabelType
method.description: Returns the type of labels, Aspect_TOCSD_AUTO by default. Aspect_TOCSD_AUTO - labels as boundary values for intervals Aspect_TOCSD_USER - user specified label is used

method.name: SetLabelType
method.description: Sets the type of labels. Aspect_TOCSD_AUTO - labels as boundary values for intervals Aspect_TOCSD_USER - user specified label is used

method.name: GetColorType
method.description: Returns the type of colors, Aspect_TOCSD_AUTO by default. Aspect_TOCSD_AUTO - value between Red and Blue Aspect_TOCSD_USER - user specified color from color map

method.name: SetColorType
method.description: Sets the type of colors. Aspect_TOCSD_AUTO - value between Red and Blue Aspect_TOCSD_USER - user specified color from color map

method.name: GetNumberOfIntervals
method.description: Returns the number of color scale intervals, 10 by default.

method.name: SetNumberOfIntervals
method.description: Sets the number of color scale intervals.

method.name: GetIntervalColor
method.description: Returns the user specified color from color map with index (starts at 1). Returns default color if index is out of range in color map.

method.name: SetIntervalColor
method.description: Sets the color of the specified interval. Note that list is automatically resized to include specified index.

method.name: GetLabels
method.description: Returns the user specified labels.

method.name: Labels
method.description: Returns the user specified labels.

method.name: SetLabels
method.description: Sets the color scale labels. The length of the sequence should be equal to GetNumberOfIntervals() or to GetNumberOfIntervals() + 1 if IsLabelAtBorder() is true. If length of the sequence does not much the number of intervals, then these labels will be considered as "free" and will be located at the virtual intervals corresponding to the number of labels (with flag IsLabelAtBorder() having the same effect as in normal case).

method.name: GetColors_2
method.description: Returns the user specified colors.

method.name: GetColors_1
method.description: Returns the user specified colors.

method.name: SetColors
method.description: Sets the color scale colors. The length of the sequence should be equal to GetNumberOfIntervals().

method.name: SetUniformColors
method.description: Populates colors scale by colors of the same lightness value in CIE Lch color space, distributed by hue, with perceptually uniform differences between consequent colors. See MakeUniformColors() for description of parameters.

method.name: GetLabelPosition
method.description: Returns the position of labels concerning color filled rectangles, Aspect_TOCSP_RIGHT by default.

method.name: SetLabelPosition
method.description: Sets the color scale labels position relative to color bar.

method.name: GetTitlePosition
method.description: Returns the position of color scale title, Aspect_TOCSP_LEFT by default.

method.name: SetTitlePosition
method.description: Sets the color scale title position.

method.name: IsReversed
method.description: Returns TRUE if the labels and colors used in reversed order, FALSE by default. - Normal, bottom-up order with Minimal value on the Bottom and Maximum value on Top. - Reversed, top-down order with Maximum value on the Bottom and Minimum value on Top.

method.name: SetReversed
method.description: Sets true if the labels and colors used in reversed order.

method.name: IsSmoothTransition
method.description: Return TRUE if color transition between neighbor intervals should be linearly interpolated, FALSE by default.

method.name: SetSmoothTransition
method.description: Setup smooth color transition.

method.name: IsLabelAtBorder
method.description: Returns TRUE if the labels are placed at border of color intervals, TRUE by default. The automatically generated label will show value exactly on the current position: - value connecting two neighbor intervals (TRUE) - value in the middle of interval (FALSE)

method.name: SetLabelAtBorder
method.description: Sets true if the labels are placed at border of color intervals (TRUE by default). If set to False, labels will be drawn at color intervals rather than at borders.

method.name: IsLogarithmic
method.description: Returns TRUE if the color scale has logarithmic intervals, FALSE by default.

method.name: SetLogarithmic
method.description: Sets true if the color scale has logarithmic intervals.

method.name: GetSize
method.description: Returns the size of color bar, 0 and 0 by default (e.g. should be set by user explicitly before displaying).

method.name: SetSize
method.description: Sets the size of color bar.

method.name: GetBreadth
method.description: Returns the breadth of color bar, 0 by default (e.g. should be set by user explicitly before displaying).

method.name: SetBreadth
method.description: Sets the width of color bar.

method.name: GetHeight
method.description: Returns the height of color bar, 0 by default (e.g. should be set by user explicitly before displaying).

method.name: SetHeight
method.description: Sets the height of color bar.

method.name: GetPosition
method.description: Returns the bottom-left position of color scale, 0x0 by default.

method.name: SetPosition
method.description: Sets the position of color scale.

method.name: GetXPosition
method.description: Returns the left position of color scale, 0 by default.

method.name: SetXPosition
method.description: Sets the left position of color scale.

method.name: GetYPosition
method.description: Returns the bottom position of color scale, 0 by default.

method.name: SetYPosition
method.description: Sets the bottom position of color scale.

method.name: GetTextHeight
method.description: Returns the font height of text labels, 20 by default.

method.name: SetTextHeight
method.description: Sets the height of text of color scale.

method.name: AcceptDisplayMode
method.description: Return true if specified display mode is supported.

method.name: Compute
method.description: Compute presentation.

method.name: ComputeSelection
method.description: Compute selection - not implemented for color scale.

method.name: FindColor_2
method.description: Calculate color according passed value; returns true if value is in range or false, if isn't

method.name: MakeUniformColors
method.description: Generates sequence of colors of the same lightness value in CIE Lch color space (see #Quantity_TOC_CIELch), with hue values in the specified range. The colors are distributed across the range such as to have perceptually same difference between neighbour colors. For each color, maximal chroma value fitting in sRGB gamut is used.
